# Payload checkpoint percentages

Source: [Payload Progress Percentage at Checkpoints](../archive/1714.md); page edited 2022-11-12.

Read [behavior and limitations](../articles/1714.md#wiki-1714) before using these values.

Source measured with 7829N at 50% payload speed and says speed affects precision. Archived 2022-11-12; these are approximate observations, not exact current map constants.
